snippet.title: Blade of Mercy: Bloody Countess | Reveal Trailer 2026
snippet.description:
Blade of Mercy: Bloody Countess is a 2D action with metroidvania elements set in a 16th-century fantasy world, drawn with cozy pixels. 
Explore a mysterious, perilous realm, battle ruthless enemies, and uncover powerful weapons and abilities. 
And remember: beer is the best medicine in these grim times!
Try the demo on Steam right now! (link in the comments)
